A full card image re-made by the Players Committee with the mark D-E1 in the lower border (16 August 2023). Its words are Decipher's errata from the Glossary Version 2.0 (November 1998) with one change: a comma is added after “character” (“character, or vehicle”) and it reads “Target hit if total destiny” where Decipher has “Target hit if destiny”.

== What changed on the image ==
[[File:Hoth-L-golanlaserbattery-PC-Errata-D-E1-changes.png|none|900px|Before and after]]
Compared with [[Golan Laser Battery (PC Errata 2018 E card)]] (by 8 July 2018): The whole card is drawn again at 745 × 1039 pixels: sharper art and frame, lore and game text set again, and the mark “D-E1” in place of “E”. The game text reads: “Deploy on any exterior planet site. Your warrior present may target a creature, character, or vehicle at same or adjacent site using 2 Force. Draw destiny. Add 2 if targeting a creature or character. Target hit if total destiny &gt; defense value.” (a comma is added after “character” (“character, or vehicle”) and it reads “Target hit if total destiny” where Decipher has “Target hit if destiny”).

The whole 2018 image and the whole D-E1 image, both scaled to 500 pixels wide; nothing else is edited.
